blurb:
Explore the Hollywood Walk of Fame at your own pace with this immersive self-guided walking tour. Using your smartphone, discover iconic landmarks, rich history, and fascinating insider stories as you stroll down this legendary street. With the flexibility to stop or explore more at your leisure, this tour is perfect whether you have just 20 minutes or a couple of hours. Available in 11 languages, it provides expert narration to enrich your experience, highlighting the stars, historic theaters, and pop culture moments that define Hollywood.

- Duration: Up to 2 hours, adaptable to your schedule
- Available in 11 languages for a personalized experience
- Discover insider stories and hidden details of Hollywood
- Perfect for those looking to explore independently with expert guidance
